title: Full sample materialization
software_contract: Normalize every row and materialize every element of every requested output copy.
input_domain: rows is a list of integer lists; copies >= 0; rows with zero total absolute magnitude normalize to zeros.
execution_assumptions: The caller consumes the complete nested classical output, not a summary, sample or optimum.
All copies must be distinct mutable lists, in input order.
The workload is large when rows/copies grow; no search predicate or optimization objective is specified.
